tuning_finished_window.name: Tuning: avg power over finished window

tuning_post_cycle_window.name: Tuning: avg power over post-cycle window

data_description.start_threshold: Power above this level signals the appliance has started. Starting is judged on the live reading, so a cycle is picked up immediately.
data_description.start_delay: Seconds power must stay at or above the start threshold before the cycle begins. Useful for appliances with a brief startup spike that isn't a real cycle start. Leave at 0 unless you actually see false starts — values larger than your sensor's update interval can cause real cycles to be missed.
data_description.finished_window: Length of the sliding window the average is taken over. No check runs until a full window of readings from the current phase exists, so this is also the shortest phase that can be detected. Its length is set by the appliance's rhythm — long enough that the phase below the threshold never falls silent for a whole window. Set to 0 to judge each reading on its own.
data_description.post_cycle_enabled: Enable for appliances that keep drawing power after the programme ends — anti-crease tumbling, drying, cooling. Splits the end of a cycle into two states: the programme being done, and the appliance going quiet afterwards. Without it, both are reported as one 'finished'.
data_description.post_cycle_window: Sliding window for the post-cycle average. It must be long enough that the working phase never looks this quiet, so appliances that draw continuously while working can use a much shorter one.
data_description.finished_power_threshold: The cycle counts as finished once the appliance averages less than this much power across the window. This threshold discriminates: put it in the gap between what the appliance draws while idling after the programme and what it draws in standby, clear of the spikes of both. A window of 0 compares each reading as it arrives instead.
data_description.post_cycle_power_threshold: The programme counts as done once the appliance averages less than this much power across the post-cycle window. Must sit above the appliance's post-cycle draw and below its quietest working phase — enable the tuning sensors to read both bands off one graph and pick a value between them.

confirm_non_power.title: Sensor is not a power sensor
confirm_non_power.description:
The selected sensor `{entity_id}` reports device class `{device_class}`. This integration expects a power sensor (watts). Energy sensors (kWh, monotonically increasing) will not work — the state machine relies on the value dropping when the appliance finishes.

Submit to continue anyway, or cancel and select a different sensor.

error.sensor_not_found: The selected sensor entity was not found.
error.sensor_not_numeric: The selected sensor does not report a numeric value.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured.
